plans:
Findings vs CLAUDE.md, and fixes:

1. plugins/diagrams/.claude-plugin/plugin.json: name "diagram" ≠ folder → set "name": "diagrams".
2. .claude-plugin/marketplace.json: no "diagrams" entry → add it.
3. plugins/avatar-video/.claude-plugin/plugin.json: no description → add one.
4. plugins/outlook-email/.claude-plugin/plugin.json: no version → add "0.1.0".
5. plugins/x-assistant/skills/xhs-post/SKILL.md: frontmatter lacks description → add one.
6. plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-scripter.md: frontmatter lacks name → add "name: video-scripter".
7. README.md: missing rows for `plugins/x-assistant/skills/youtube-post/` and `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-reviewer.md` → add both.
8. .claude/skills/quick-notes/ is a real directory, not a symlink to a plugin → move it to plugins/notes/skills/quick-notes/ (new plugin: plugin.json + marketplace entry + README row) and replace .claude/skills/quick-notes with the symlink. Say so if you'd rather it live inside an existing plugin (e.g. x-assistant).
9. .claude/skills/x-image: symlink missing → ln -s ../../plugins/x-assistant/skills/x-image.
10. .claude/skills/voice-video: broken symlink (points at .../skills/voice_video) → repoint to .../skills/voice-video.
11. .claude/agents/x-reviewer.md: symlink missing → ln -s ../../plugins/x-assistant/agents/x-reviewer.md.
12. .claude/agents/x-drafter.md and video-reviewer.md are real copies, not symlinks → replace with the required symlinks (contents are identical to the plugin files).

Untouched: .claude/skills/{heygen-avatar,heygen-video,hyperframes,media-use}.

Then I re-read every changed file and re-check the link targets to confirm all six rules hold.
final:
All checks pass (the repo isn't a git checkout, so `git status` isn't available — verification was via a script over the files and links).

| # | What was wrong | What I changed |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `plugins/diagrams/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` had `"name": "diagram"` ≠ folder name | Set to `"diagrams"` |
| 2 | `plugins/diagrams` had no entry in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` | Added a `diagrams` entry |
| 3 | `plugins/avatar-video/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` had no `description` | Added `"The avatar-video plugin."` |
| 4 | `plugins/outlook-email/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` had no `version` | Added `"0.1.0"` |
| 5 | `plugins/x-assistant/skills/xhs-post/SKILL.md` frontmatter had no `description` | Added one (kept the `---` fence intact) |
| 6 | `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-scripter.md` frontmatter had no `name` | Added `name: video-scripter` |
| 7 | README.md had no row for `youtube-post` skill or `video-reviewer` subagent | Added both rows |
| 8 | `.claude/skills/quick-notes` was a real directory, i.e. a skill living directly in `.claude/` | Moved it to `plugins/notes/skills/quick-notes/`, created `plugins/notes/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, added a `notes` marketplace entry + README row, and replaced it with the symlink `../../plugins/notes/skills/quick-notes` |
| 9 | `.claude/skills/x-image` was missing | Linked it to `../../plugins/x-assistant/skills/x-image` |
| 10 | `.claude/skills/voice-video` was a broken symlink (`skills/voice_video`) | Repointed to `../../plugins/avatar-video/skills/voice-video` |
| 11 | `.claude/agents/x-reviewer.md` was missing | Linked it to `../../plugins/x-assistant/agents/x-reviewer.md` |

One thing I did *not* change: I first suspected `.claude/agents/x-drafter.md` and `video-reviewer.md` were copies rather than symlinks, but `ls -la` showed they are already correct symlinks. The third-party skills were left untouched.
